title: The newly wired EGW fallback still needs original-response replay, an independent provider start and exact team identity before it is safe
detail: Read-only recheck on 2026-10-24: main a0c08fa and PR #246 head 67d1356 now load automated EGW entries, so the old missing-loader warning no longer describes them.
